data.exact_reserve_text: Driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications, the 2013 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 5.9%.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Loss on capacity of 5.9% driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications

data.standardized_narrative: No explicit gross prioryear reserve movement amount is disclosed. The report notes adverse development for prior years, specifically that the 2013 year of account "declares a loss on capacity of 5.9%" driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications. No quantified gross prioryear movement (insurance liabilities) is provided in the movement notes; the gross claims development table is present at group level but does not supply a clear syndicate gross PYD figure extractable for 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: Driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications, the 2013 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 5.9%.
The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's financial position is the estimate for losses incurred but not reported.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross movement in 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' is presented. The technical provisions movement lines show aggregate movements (including current year) but do not isolate prioryear development as a gross insurance liabilities figure. A gross claims development triangle is present (group level and a small 3622 share row) but the document does not provide the required priordiagonal development rows for the syndicate share to calculate a reliable gross PYD. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null.
